events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
events.titleJa: Copilot チャットのプランナー機能 (M365 Copilot)
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Planner capabilities in Copilot chat (M365 Copilot)
events.summary: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.
events.summaryJa: M365 Copilot チャットで Planner タスクと Planner 情報をクエリする計画の作成をサポートし、ユーザーが Copilot と Planner の間でタスクと計画をシームレスに管理できるようにします。
events.summaryEn: We will support creating Planner tasks and plans querying Planner information in M365 Copilot chat, allowing users to manage their tasks and plans between Copilot and Planner seamlessly.

events.title: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Readiness in Microsoft Copilot Studio
events.titleJa: Microsoft Copilot Studio でのエージェントの準備状況
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot Studio: Agent Readiness in Microsoft Copilot Studio
events.summary: Agent Readiness gives makers a real-time, always-visible health check for their Copilot Studio agents. A single "Review" indicator in the build experience surfaces anything blocking or at risk — from policy restrictions to missing evaluations — before it derails a publish. Blocked capabilities are grayed out up front...

events.title: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Export Copilot metrics in the Copilot Dashboard
events.titleJa: Copilot ダッシュボードで Copilot メトリックをエクスポートする
events.titleEn: Microsoft Copilot (Microsoft 365): Export Copilot metrics in the Copilot Dashboard
events.summary: This enables users to export row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis.
events.summaryJa: これにより、ユーザーはレポート作成やより詳細な分析のために、Copilot ダッシュボードから行レベルの Copilot メトリクスをエクスポートできるようになります。
events.summaryEn: This enables users to export row-level Copilot metrics from the Copilot Dashboard for reporting and deeper analysis.
